name: Shoko Relay
overview: A custom metadata provider and automation toolset for integrating Plex and AnimeThemes with Shoko Server.

releases.release_notes:
For this release force refreshing the dashboard (`Ctrl-F5`) may be required for all of the front end changes to take effect.

**Changes:**
- Automatically append newly downloaded AnimeThemes WebM files directly to `anidb_animethemes_xrefs.csv` upon download completion
- Implement targeted Plex API fast-paths in `CollectionService`, `CriticRatingService`, and `ImageSyncService` to bypass full-library fetches during filtered requests and debounced VFS fixups
- Replace the "Cour" number input with a "Current Season Filter" toggle button on the dashboard for Theme.mp3 batch generation
- Fix potential race conditions during concurrent path translations by storing cached mappings in atomic immutable arrays
- Embed `PackageID`, `PackageName`, and `PackageOverview` identity metadata directly via MSBuild to satisfy Shoko Server pre-load verification
- Optimize AnimeThemes mapping root discovery by querying managed folders directly instead of enumerating all database video files
- Unify Plex HTTP communications through `PlexClient.SendAsync` and remove redundant `HttpClient` dependencies across sub-services
- Enhance `SourceLinkService` logging to track individually created or purged symlinks and attachment folders in reports
- Prefix release archive checksums with `sha256:` in build workflows to align with the updated plugin manifest schema
- Micro-optimize artwork MIME type resolution (`FrozenDictionary`), Unicode unescaping, tag blacklist filtering, and config reflection
- Bump `Shoko.Abstractions` to `v6.0.0-alpha.82`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.17.2...v0.17.3

**Changes:**
- Added a Source Folder view toggle to the AnimeThemes Player to organize themes chronologically (Year -> Season -> Series -> Theme)
- Updated AnimeThemes Player search indexing to support filtering by original source folder names
- Refined inline Plex extra detection to verify the physical existence of a base video file before ignoring extras
- Replaced hardcoded video extension lists with Shoko Server's dynamic IsAllowedVideoExtension configuration
- Accelerated path ignore evaluation and separator scanning using SIMD vectorization and zero-allocation span matching
- Centralized reverse-proxy-safe URL routing (shokoBase) and HTML escaping across frontend scripts
- Refactored and DRYed up DOM tree node creation across the VFS Browser and AnimeThemes Player
- Added comprehensive XML documentation and standardized JSDoc annotations across the project


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.17.1...v0.17.2

After updating to this version, users of the dedicated Movie VFS (or those who often have multiple files for the same episode) should run a full VFS regeneration.

**Changes:**
- Update standalone Movie VFS filename generation to use 'Movie [{ShokoFileID}]' naming convention
- Standardize duplicate file collision suffix from '-v#' to '-dup#' across standard and movie VFS filenames
- Implement URL-based caching for Plex collection artwork to skip re-uploading unchanged posters, backdrops, and logos
- Update Collection Build Report and Image Sync Report statistics to display Uploaded vs Already Uploaded counts
- Fix external subtitle and sidecar linking in standalone Movie VFS (LinkEpisodeMetadata)
- Ensure merged series resolve primary series IDs when triggering plex metadata refreshes/analysis
- Ensure merged series across multiple import roots resolve paths and refresh Plex metadata accurately
- Optimize AnimeThemes Video Player tag search filtering to eliminate GC memory allocations
- Bump Shoko.Abstractions to v6.0.0-alpha.81
- General optimizations and fixes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.17.0...v0.17.1

This is the largest release in quite some time and is primarily dedicated to adding support for movie libraries in Plex.

**Changes:**
- Added dedicated Plex Movie library support (tv.plex.agents.custom.shoko.movie scheme) with standalone Movie VFS generation (!ShokoRelayMovieVFS)
- Added m{id} movie rating keys, movie GUID resolution, and movie library support across matching, metadata, and agent endpoints
- Implemented unique TMDB poster selection, sort titles, and prioritized episode descriptions for multi-part movies
- Updated watched state, scrobble, webhook, critic ratings, image sync, and empty trash automation to natively support Movie library sections
- Expanded VFS Browser to render, merge, and navigate Movie branches, local extra subdirectories, and direct metadata links
- Added zero-width and hair space formatting to Opening and Ending extra titles to bypass Plex's automatic prefix truncation
- Refined theme selection priority (lowest-numbered OP -> lowest-numbered ED) and added ED upgrade checks to the MP3 audit tool
- Updated Collection Build, Discovery, and Task Reports to segregate TV Shows and Movie libraries, including tracking deleted empty collections (REMOVED:)
- Automatically strip trailing AniDB moderator comments (--) from tag names in TagHelper
- Added Cache-Control headers to VFS tree endpoint responses to prevent stale browser caching
- Optimized database lookups in MetadataController match logic and performed general code cleanups and documentation updates
- Updated README/Controller.md with details on the new functionality

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/natyusha/ShokoRelay/compare/v0.16.9...v0.17.0
